verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Solid's reactive primitives (signals, derived state, stores, automatic dependency tracking) and SSR or custom-renderer support. Nothing documents testing utilities or shows that reactive state and logic can be unit tested in isolation from DOM rendering. Framework-agnostic primitives and server runtimes are adjacent building blocks, not a documented testing capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can unit test my reactive state and logic without needing to render the DOM
